shipped_rows.title_o: Validation of DNA-Based Prognostic Testing to Predict Spinal Curve Progression in Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis
shipped_rows.authors_o: Ward; Ogilvie; Singleton; Chettier; Engler; Nelson

blind_target.evidence_quote: To determine whether the 53 single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) that were previously associated with spinal deformity progression in an American Caucasian cohort are similarly associated in French-Canadian population.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Although the 52 SNPs studied here were previously associated with curve progression in an American population of European descent, we found no association in French-Canadian patients with adolescent idiopathic scoliosis.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The conclusion explicitly contrasts the prior associations with their absence in this sample.

luna_triage.reason: The abstract establishes a retest of previously reported ScoliScore SNP associations in a separate French-Canadian sample, but it supplies no citation or report identity for the American Caucasian cohort. The supplied Ward et al. row concerns DNA-based prognostic testing and may be the same originating report, but the abstract alone does not establish that equivalence. Need the cited primary report/reference for the US cohort to determine whether row 1129 represents the same original work.
luna_triage.omission_quote: Although the 52 SNPs studied here were previously associated with curve progression in an American population of European descent, we found no association in French-Canadian patients with adolescent idiopathic scoliosis.

quality_gate: Luna is triage only. Independently establish actual empirical retesting and absence under ALL shipped identities/alternate reports. Read prior objections. No paper outcome is being requested.
